# infrawrench_expiry_alert_settings (Resource)

How much notice the expiry radar gives before a certificate, domain or commitment deadline arrives.

An organization **singleton**, with no DELETE on the route: `terraform destroy` leaves the stored settings alone.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the poller sends expiry alerts for this organization at all.
- `lead_days` (Number) Days of lead time before a deadline counts as upcoming and alertable, 1–365. Ships as 60.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id. Expiry alerting is an organization singleton, so this is the only value it ever takes and it is what `terraform import` addresses.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organization singleton: there is only ever one, and it has no id of its
# own, so it imports under the organization id.
terraform import infrawrench_expiry_alert_settings.this org_01HXYZABCDEF
```
